title: Small display bugs for DynISF
body:
* Both on AAPS and AAPSclient : when using DynISF, the arrows icon has the cross, I guess it's only activated for Autosens, but it should also be activated when DynISF is on. 
* On AAPSClient only : I turn off my phone at night. When I turn it on in the morning, AAPSClient usually picks up everything that happened during the night. But not the DynISF white curve.
* Both on AAPS and AAPSclient : the widget still shows AS %, it has been removed in main screen in 3.3.1.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/96693b26-6651-4207-8c2c-085cc325fcbb)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a8a38b9d-477a-47b7-8135-55409a31550b)

comments.body:
Some feedback on first bullet point: 
If you activate Dynamic sensitivity's own TDD-based "autosens", you'll see that the icon looses it's X. That's the only way at the moment for AAPSClient to know that this TDD-based "autosens" is activated. The value of this sensitivity isn't passed yet.

Second bullet point:
If you restart AAPSClient, or change from 6h to 12h, does it calculate?

Third bullet point:
AS% in AAPS overview only show if not equal to 100%. This wasn't implemented to widget, so not exactly a bug, but I agree should probably function same as overview.
